goals.globalTargetLabel: 5,000 development catalogue candidates; baseline scope 1,000 Pacific, 8 Caribbean maintained separately

classification: This file holds 4,000 unverified source-derived candidate names, NOT complete biological profiles or approved species; no AphiaIDs assigned.

snapshotSources.usage: Reef fish species names, family, historical FishBase SpecCode and unverified reported maximum size; no current accepted-name claim.
Marine fishery biodiversity names and family/division associations; 412 of 2,135 full-source dataset matches are genus/family derived.
Sea turtle checklist; green turtle already in Caribbean pack.

limitations: Candidate scientific names may be outdated, unaccepted, spelling-variant or taxonomic synonyms; resolve with WoRMS using EXACT matches and accepted_AphiaID before promoting.
Source sizes in the reef list are not necessarily total length; do not import into app measurement fields without a measurement type and original source check.
No source-derived descriptions, colors, morphology or regions are claimed; a blank field is unknown.
WorldFish IHH mapping includes genus/family inferred associations; source division labels are not identity verification.
Global reef and fishery inclusion is NOT evidence of occurrence in Tropical Pacific or Caribbean.
No original source images have been imported, and no image rights have been granted.
Some reef species may be cryptic, deep-water, or not encountered by recreational divers; score dive relevance before publication.
There may be accepted-taxon duplicates after WoRMS resolution; use reserve queue to replace collisions while keeping actual counts, not fabricate extra records.
Do not merge global candidates into an existing regional app pack until independent regional-presence evidence is recorded.
Preserve catalogue 1000 + Caribbean 8 and frozen search evaluation unchanged; separate PRs and halt on regressed results.
